units.source_text: 话音刚落，他就重重地敲打了一下白槌。

en.t: As soon as the words left his mouth, he struck the white mallet heavily.

units.source_text: 这一响彻方丈室的槌声，又使我认识到老师掌握的权力是多么的灵验。

en.t: The sound of the mallet ringing through the abbot's chamber made me realize once again how potent the power held by the teacher was.
